summary: Ported the timing card, dual-thumb range slider, two-row timing pills, and value boxes with select-all-on-focus to egui in src/ui2/timing.rs. All 4 SOCD modes (Immediate, PressDelay, ReleaseDelay, RandomMix), conditional timing groups, mix ratio slider, mechanism steps, and value editing/read-back are fully implemented and verified via 11 in-file unit tests; registration in src/ui2/mod.rs and egui_kittest in Cargo.toml are reported as integration prerequisites.

tests.note: Worktree run: 105 passed. When temporarily registered in src/ui2/mod.rs during implementation verification, all 116 tests passed, including all 11 unit tests in src/ui2/timing.rs.
Worktree run: clean with 0 warnings. Verified clean both with and without timing.rs registration in mod.rs.

risks: Integration prerequisite (module registration): src/ui2/mod.rs must declare `pub mod timing;`. Until then, src/ui2/timing.rs is an unregistered module in the worktree and cannot be compiled during standard crate builds.

Integration prerequisite (dev-dependency): egui_kittest is not yet in Cargo.toml [dev-dependencies]; adding it is owned by T8/Integrator. Value box editing and read-back were tested and verified using egui's built-in run_ui and TextEdit load_state/cursor range APIs.

Palette alignment: Theme constants in src/ui2/timing.rs match src/ui/theme.rs verbatim (IMMEDIATE_ACCENT, INDIGO_600/700/800, VIOLET_600, MIX_TEXT, PRIMARY_TEXT, MUTED_TEXT, BODY_TEXT, BORDER, SURFACE, INSET, SLATE_100, SLATE_300, ERROR_TEXT, ERROR_BG, ERROR_BORDER, RELEASE_TEXT). When T2's src/ui2/theme.rs is merged by the Integrator, timing.rs can cleanly import from ui2::theme.
Workers T2 and T3 are compiling concurrently in separate worktrees; their unmerged files are not present in this worktree and did not affect compilation.
